Market today: The mood is cautious, especially in chips. Nvidia's significant losing streak is the main driver, directly hitting your concentrated tech/chip names. The FAA grounding adds a layer of broader market uncertainty.

Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETFs are bleeding hard. SOXL is down a brutal -74.05%, MUU -53.8%, and SPAL -46.16%. These are all "SELL" status and on margin, amplifying the pain. QQQI (-8.81%), QQQ (-4.87%), and SNOW (-13.04%) are also near their "TRIM" stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the semiconductor sector's reaction to the ongoing Nvidia weakness. Also, monitor the broader market's response to the FAA system outage.

Bottom line: Your deep losses in leveraged chip plays, combined with Nvidia's slump, demand immediate risk management.
plays: SOXL: Your -74.05% loss on this leveraged chip ETF is extreme. Respect the "SELL" status and consider exiting or significantly reducing this position immediately. The stop at 200 is long gone.
MUU/SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are also down over 45% and marked "SELL." Review their stops (MUU 31.6, SPAL 21.38) and consider trimming or exiting to reduce margin exposure.
SOXS: Given the Nvidia news and your chip concentration, consider a small hedge. The scanner shows a "LONG" setup for SOXS (inverse semi) at entry 50.51-50.3, stop 49.5.
